command: cd /workspace; ls; cat mcp.json | sed 's/\(Bearer \)[^"]*/\1***/'; which mcpjam; npx --no-install mcpjam --help 2>&1 | head -30
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | head -c 2500; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://fixture:8765/mcp
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -i -E "cli|api|eval" | head; npm view @mcpjam/cli version 2>&1 | head -3
cd /workspace; curl -s https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | head -c 4000; npm view @mcpjam/cli bin 2>&1|head -3
cd /workspace; export M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; $M server doctor --help 2>&1 | head -30; $M server probe --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" 2>&1 | head -30

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; A="--url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token $MCP_SERVER_TOKEN"; $M server doctor $A --out doctor.json 2>&1 | head -c 1500; echo; $M tools list $A 2>&1 | head -c 2000

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; A="--url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token $MCP_SERVER_TOKEN"; $M tools call $A --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | head -c 800; echo; $M tools call $A --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":"x"}' 2>&1 | head -c 600; $M server validate $A 2>&1 | head -c 800

cd /workspace; cat > validate.sh <<'E'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: MCP_SERVER_TOKEN=[REDACTED] ./validate.sh
M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest"; A="--url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token $MCP_SERVER_TOKEN"
$M server doctor $A --out doctor.json >/dev/null 2>&1
$M tools list $A
$M tools call $A --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}'
$M tools call $A --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":"x"}'
E
chmod +x validate.sh
